reading_rule: Names pinned to anchors, which district_names.apply sets over the generated names and the calques. An anchor is what a unit is tied to that a redraw keeps: sea:<body> for one of the seven seas, feature:<IAU name> for the unit that carries a named feature, crater:<IAU name> for a district centred on that crater, region:<its largest district's anchor> for a region, and the centre's kind and place otherwise. A pin gives the name, its tongue where it differs from the unit's, and its meaning. Edit a pin and run python -m research.studies.atlas_round.district_names to rename the record without drawing it again.

sea:near-side sea.name: Uamoana
sea:near-side sea.meaning: Rain Sea (ua rain + moana sea), after Mare Imbrium, the Sea of Showers, its largest basin

sea:southern near-side seas.name: Bultengiz
sea:southern near-side seas.meaning: Cloud Sea (bult cloud + tengiz sea), after Mare Nubium, the Sea of Clouds

sea:South Pole–Aitken Sea.name: H'Jamo Melaĥa
sea:South Pole–Aitken Sea.meaning: the Salt Sea (h' the + jamo sea + melaĥa salt); in its Hebrew roots also the Dead Sea's name

sea:Mare Humboldtianum.name: Juldyztengiz
sea:Mare Humboldtianum.meaning: Star Sea (juldyz star + tengiz sea), towards the northern limb

sea:Mare Moscoviense.name: Hanaqucha
sea:Mare Moscoviense.meaning: Upper Lake (hanaq upper + qucha lake), 3.4 km above the common level

sea:Mare Orientale.name: Bahari Mashariki
sea:Mare Orientale.meaning: East Sea (bahari sea + mashariki east), after Mare Orientale, the Eastern Sea

sea:Smythii–Marginis Sea.name: Dagat na Katzeh
sea:Smythii–Marginis Sea.meaning: Sea of the Edge (dagat sea + na + katzeh edge), after Mare Marginis

feature:Sinus Iridum.name: Anuanuafanga
feature:Sinus Iridum.meaning: Rainbow Bay: the Terlunan name for the Bay of Rainbows (Sinus Iridum), in the author's v0.6 reference

feature:Montes Jura.name: Jura
feature:Montes Jura.meaning: the Jura mountains round the Bay of Rainbows, a proper name Terlunan keeps in its established form (v0.6), as in the author's song

feature:Mare Ingenii.name: Ingenii
feature:Mare Ingenii.meaning: the Sea of Cleverness (Mare Ingenii) in the salt sea, a proper name Terlunan keeps in its established form (v0.6)
